purpose: the null an activity-conditioned generator must beat, AND a measurement of whether the oracle's activity signal is k-mer-expressible at all
verdict_detail: The stratified 4-mer null captures 53.6% of the ACHIEVABLE monotonicity (ceiling 0.3729 from real sequence stratified by its own measured activity), while an UNCONDITIONED chain captures 1.4% -- so the signal genuinely comes from the conditioning and not from the generation process. A real bar with 46.4% room left. A generator must be quoted against BOTH the null and the ceiling; beating the null while far below the ceiling is a partial result.

verdict_recomputed.why: The original rule used an ABSOLUTE threshold of rho>=0.30 for k-mer-expressibility, frozen before the ceiling was known. The measured ceiling is 0.3729, so that bar sat at 80% of achievable and labelled a null capturing 53.6% of achievable signal WEAK. The verdict is now a fraction of the measured ceiling, which has no such failure mode. FOURTH threshold this session to misdescribe its data the same way: an absolute bar set before the scale was measured.
